provisions.quotation: No AI vendor may access district data without an executed DCS Data Processing & Security Agreement and adherence to district data minimization and deletion schedules.
provisions.scope: district data accessed by an AI vendor
provisions.conditions: Access requires an executed agreement and adherence to district deletion schedules.
provisions.notes: Schedule contents, deadlines, and backup coverage are not supplied.

provisions.quotation: Duration of data usage.
provisions.scope: data provided for AI-system training
provisions.conditions: Adjacent paragraph says the RFA written explanation shall include these items.
provisions.notes: Required disclosure field, not a retention limit.

provisions.quotation: Deletion of training data or training data will be returned by a certain date. If retention is required by law or contract, the vendor must segregate and protect retained data and provide a deletion certificate by the agreed date.
provisions.timing_detail: by a certain date; by the agreed date
provisions.scope: training data; retained data only if retention is required by law or contract
provisions.conditions: Deletion or return is stated as an alternative; legally/contractually retained data must be segregated and protected.
provisions.notes: Certificate is explicit evidence of deletion confirmation; no actual date is provided.

provisions.quotation: A statement that no training data has been stored.
provisions.scope: training data
provisions.conditions: A statement to include in the model-training completion explanation.
provisions.notes: Disclosure/representation, not an independently verified fact.

provisions.quotation: Does the vendor provide clear policies for how long data is retained and when it will be deleted?
provisions.scope: student, employee, or user data collected by the tool
provisions.conditions: Vendor-review checklist question.
provisions.notes: Question only; no substantive period.

provisions.quotation: retention/deletion, data return, certified deletion, audit or verification rights
provisions.actor: school system and vendor negotiating a DSA
provisions.scope: data covered by a possible DSA
provisions.conditions: Checklist asks whether a DSA procedure includes these terms if needed.
provisions.notes: Certified deletion/verification is a term to check, not confirmation that data was deleted.

provisions.quotation: Upon termination or non-renewal, does the vendor return all school-system data in a usable format and certify deletion within a defined period, including deletion from backups, subprocessors, derived datasets, and any model-training corpora where applicable?
provisions.scope: all school-system data, including backups, subprocessors, derived datasets, and model-training corpora where applicable
provisions.conditions: Checklist question applies upon termination or non-renewal; data return is also requested.
provisions.notes: Review criterion, not an assertion that these contract terms exist or deletion occurred.

provisions.quotation: Districts must clearly communicate what AI tools are used, what data are collected, how long data are retained, and when opt-out options apply
provisions.scope: data collected by AI tools
provisions.conditions: Communication to families using accessible and culturally responsive formats.
provisions.notes: Disclosure requirement, not a retention limit.

provisions.quotation: Districts must ensure contractual limits on data use, retention, and deletion
provisions.scope: data handled under AI vendor contracts
provisions.conditions: Vendor expectation in a district framework; no substantive limit stated.
provisions.notes: Requires contractual limits but does not specify them.

provisions.quotation: Districts must ensure contractual limits on data use, retention, and deletion
provisions.scope: data handled under AI vendor contracts
provisions.conditions: Vendor expectation in a district framework; no deletion process stated.
provisions.notes: Separate deletion aspect of the same contractual-limits clause.

provisions.quotation: data collection and retention
provisions.scope: data handled by vendors
provisions.conditions: Vendor documentation is required; tools lacking sufficient transparency must not be adopted.
provisions.notes: Documentation only; no retention duration.

provisions.quotation: Contracts must include data minimization, limits on data use and sharing, security and breach response requirements, bias mitigation, audit rights, and clear termination and data deletion provisions.
provisions.scope: data handled under vendor contracts
provisions.conditions: Contract must include clear termination and deletion terms; no substantive deletion timing is stated.
provisions.notes: Requires contractual provisions, not a defined deletion outcome.

provisions.quotation: Data retention and deletion policies: how long the system retains data, and the processes for securely deleting it.
provisions.scope: data held by the AI system
provisions.conditions: Districts may consider expanding the RFP questionnaire.
provisions.notes: Review/documentation prompt, not an actual retention limit.

provisions.quotation: consumer-facing prompts are often retained by vendors to train future models
provisions.scope: consumer-facing prompts
provisions.conditions: Risk overview statement.
provisions.notes: General warning, not a universal factual claim or a deletion deadline.

provisions.quotation: mandate vendor compliance with zero-data-retention terms
provisions.scope: data submitted to vendors
provisions.conditions: Listed among recommended practices.
provisions.notes: Zero-retention terms recommended; no backup scope specified.

provisions.quotation: AI tools should only be allowed to collect, process, and retain the minimum amount of data necessary to deliver the service they are providing.
provisions.scope: student data collected, processed, and retained by AI tools
provisions.conditions: Rule of thumb; data amount is limited to service necessity.
provisions.notes: No numeric duration stated; wording is a recommendation, not a mandatory law claim.

provisions.quotation: The Division shall safeguard and minimize the collection and retention of personally identifiable information (PII)
provisions.scope: personally identifiable information
provisions.conditions: General safeguard/minimization duty; the following sentence adds an approval/DPA gate.
provisions.notes: No numerical or event-based retention limit stated.

provisions.quotation: No AI system shall collect, store, or transmit PII without prior approval through the Division’s vetting process and a signed Data Privacy Agreement that defines permissible uses, retention limits, and security standards.
provisions.scope: PII
provisions.conditions: Prior Division vetting approval and signed DPA defining retention limits are both required.
provisions.notes: Conditional authorization gate; the limits themselves are not stated.

provisions.quotation: The vendor provides clear data usage and retention policies.
provisions.actor: vendor; Technology Services and Legal review
provisions.scope: vendor data
provisions.conditions: Part of required tool-verification criteria; tools failing standards shall be rejected or flagged.
provisions.notes: Policy clarity requirement, not a retention limit.

provisions.quotation: all inputs into generative AI may be retained by the AI platform
provisions.scope: all user inputs, as stated in student instruction
provisions.conditions: Student-commitment instructional statement.
provisions.notes: Warns of possible retention; not an assertion that every platform retains all inputs.

provisions.quotation: IT departments need to actively set the conversation retention settings
provisions.scope: Gemini conversations in the described Google environment
provisions.conditions: Teachers are to understand which conversations should not occur in embedded apps because of lack of retention/logging.
provisions.notes: Setting configuration is required, but no actual setting or retention duration is supplied.

provisions.quotation: Give users options to opt-out or delete their data if they want.
provisions.scope: users’ data
provisions.conditions: Guidance recommends offering users an opt-out or deletion option.
provisions.notes: No request process, deadline, actor, or confirmation is specified.

provisions.quotation: Shall be deleted within a defined period unless retention is required by law.
provisions.scope: student data collected through artificial intelligence
provisions.conditions: Exception if retention is required by law; the actual period is not given.
provisions.notes: No deadline inferred from the legal-retention exception.

provisions.quotation: A school entity or vendor shall not collect, store, or analyze biometric data, including facial recognition data, voiceprints, or emotional analysis, without case-specific written parental consent.
provisions.scope: biometric data, including facial recognition data, voiceprints, and emotional analysis
provisions.conditions: Collection, storage, or analysis is barred absent case-specific written parental consent.
provisions.notes: Conditional storage restriction; no retention period or deletion requirement stated.
